hooks.text: 白发神性少女患有社交焦虑，却把末日荒原重塑成神话种族共存并拥有The Source的新世界
hooks.excerpt: But this white-haired, god-like entity has a major case of social anxiety?! She turns the once apocalyptic, barren world into a new one filled with races and civilizations previously known only from mythology and fairy tales, and grants the mysterious power of The Source to its inhabitants, including humans.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 召唤盟友并控制战场阵形，在站位、时机和高风险决策间重塑整套牌组Build
hooks.excerpt: Voice of Belldona blends sci-fantasy atmosphere with tactical roguelike deckbuilding: summon allies, control the battlefield’s formation, and clash against everything from twisted robots to Pegasus-like divine war machines. What starts as clean strategy soon becomes a dance of positioning, timing, and high-risk decisions that can reshape your entire build.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每条地图路线都会改变可获得的卡牌，使路径选择持续改写本局牌组与战术成长
hooks.excerpt: Build your deck through every battle you fight, and every path you take can alter the cards you obtain. Shape your strategy to enhance the sense of progression and further increase the tactical depth of each run. Every choice reshapes your build, and every build opens new ways to outsmart the void.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
